data.title: 诗怀雅 · 点心推车
data.description: 她掀开蒸笼看了一眼，熟练地点了几样，又记得给你留出挑选的机会。
data.promptProse: Sitting at a round marble-top table in an authentic Lungmen dim sum parlor, Swire lifts the woven lid of a steaming bamboo basket on a passing cart to inspect fresh shrimp dumplings. White porcelain teapots and condiments crowd the table amidst lively teahouse chatter.
data.animaCaption: Lifting the bamboo steamer lid with a satisfied nod at the steaming dumplings, she signals the server to set down three baskets.
